deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.51.0 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2.0. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.

deferrals.name: MERMAID_CLI_VERSION
deferrals.reason: @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli 12.x requires Node >=22.13 but the ux-tools image runs Debian nodejs 20.19.x, producing EBADENGINE warnings. Pinned to 11.17.0 until the image moves to Node 22+.
